r20-6-001.gate_key: narrative_b2 | B2.1 | gap | When I finally got through, I ___ on hold for forty minutes. (wait) |

item.q: When I finally got through, I ___ on hold for forty minutes. (wait)
item.why: How long something went on before a moment in the past: *had been* + *-ing*.
item.why_lv: Cik ilgi kaut kas notika līdz kādam brīdim pagātnē: *had been + -ing*.

r20-6-002.gate_key: conj_clauses | B2.1 | gap | ___ the rain, we finished the hike. |

item.q: ___ the rain, we finished the hike.
item.why: *Despite / In spite of* + noun (*the rain*); *although* needs subject + verb.
item.why_lv: *Despite / In spite of* + lietvārds (*the rain*); aiz *although* vajag teikuma priekšmetu un darbības vārdu.

r20-6-003.gate_key: conj_clauses | B2.1 | gap | She wrote everything down so as ___ anything. (not / forget) |

item.q: She wrote everything down so as ___ anything. (not / forget)
item.why: Purpose, negative: *so as not to* + base form.
item.why_lv: Nolūks noliegumā: *so as not to* + pamatforma.

r20-6-004.gate_key: conj_b2 | B2.1 | gap | Take an umbrella in case it ___ later. (rain) |

item.q: Take an umbrella in case it ___ later. (rain)
item.why: After *in case* the present, not *will*.
item.why_lv: Aiz *in case* tagadne, nevis *will*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja *nu* līs", *gribas will*.

r20-6-005.gate_key: cond_third | B2.2 | gap | I would have gone to the concert if I ___ about it. (know) |

item.q: I would have gone to the concert if I ___ about it. (know)
item.why: An imagined past: *if* + *had* + 3rd form, not *would have*.
item.why_lv: Iedomāta pagātne: *if + had* + 3. forma, nevis *would have*.

r20-6-006.gate_key: cond_third | B2.2 | gap | If she hadn't checked the code, the app ___ . (crash) |

item.q: If she hadn't checked the code, the app ___ . (crash)
item.why: The result in an imagined past: *would have* + 3rd form.
item.why_lv: *Sekas* iedomātā pagātnē: *would have* + 3. forma.

r20-6-007.gate_key: rep_questions | B2.2 | gap | The doctor told me ___ anything heavy for a week. (not / lift) |

item.q: The doctor told me ___ anything heavy for a week. (not / lift)
item.why: A reported instruction: *told me not to* + base form.
item.why_lv: Atstāstīts norādījums: *told me not to* + pamatforma.

r20-6-008.gate_key: rep_verbs | B2.2 | gap | He apologised ___ late for the meeting. (be) |

item.q: He apologised ___ late for the meeting. (be)
item.why: *apologise for* + *-ing*.
item.why_lv: *apologise for + -ing*.

r20-6-009.gate_key: rep_verbs | B2.2 | gap | My colleague suggested ___ a taxi to the airport. (take) |

item.q: My colleague suggested ___ a taxi to the airport. (take)
item.why: *suggest* + *-ing* (or *suggest that we take*), never *suggest to*.
item.why_lv: *suggest + -ing* (vai *suggest that we take*), nekad *suggest to*. *Tulkojot burtiski "ieteica* paņemt", *gribas to take*.

r20-6-010.gate_key: ind_advanced | B2.2 | gap | I'm not sure what time the meeting ___ . (start) |

item.q: I'm not sure what time the meeting ___ . (start)
item.why: Inside a sentence the question has statement order, without *does*.
item.why_lv: Teikuma iekšienē jautājumam ir *apgalvojuma* secība, bez *does*.

r20-6-011.gate_key: narrative_b2 | B2.2 | gap | Her eyes were red because she ___ . (cry) |

item.q: Her eyes were red because she ___ . (cry)
item.why: The result we see, from an activity before: *had been* + *-ing*.
item.why_lv: *Redzams* rezultāts no agrākas darbības: *had been + -ing*.

r20-6-012.gate_key: cond_mixed | B2.2 | gap | If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now. (be) |

item.q: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now. (be)
item.why: A past choice with a result now: *would* + base form, because of *now*.
item.why_lv: Pagātnes izvēle ar sekām tagad: *would* + pamatforma, jo ir *now*.

r20-6-013.gate_key: cond_mixed | B2.2 | gap | If I ___ so shy, I would have spoken to her at the party. (not / be) |

item.q: If I ___ so shy, I would have spoken to her at the party. (not / be)
item.why: A quality now (*so shy*) with a result in the past: *if* + past.
item.why_lv: Īpašība tagad (*so shy*) ar sekām pagātnē: *if* + pagātne.

r20-6-014.gate_key: conj_b2 | B2.2 | gap | Sales fell sharply; ___ , the company cut its prices. |

item.q: Sales fell sharply; ___ , the company cut its prices.
item.why: A result as a new step after a semicolon: *therefore*, *as a result*.
item.why_lv: Rezultāts kā jauns *solis* aiz *semikola*: *therefore, as a result*.

r20-6-015.gate_key: cond_mixed | B2.2 | gap | If she ___ the job in London, she would be living there now. (accept) |

item.q: If she ___ the job in London, she would be living there now. (accept)
item.why: A past event with a result now: *if* + *had* + 3rd form.
item.why_lv: Pagātnes notikums ar sekām tagad: *if + had* + 3. forma.

r20-6-016.gate_key: cond_advanced | B2.2 | gap | I wish I ___ more time to travel this year. (have) |

item.q: I wish I ___ more time to travel this year. (have)
item.why: A wish about now: *wish* + past.
item.why_lv: Vēlēšanās par tagadni: *wish* + pagātne. *Tulkojot burtiski* "es gribētu, lai man būtu", *gribas would have*.

r20-6-017.gate_key: cond_advanced | B2.2 | gap | I wish I ___ that comment in the meeting yesterday. (not / make) |

item.q: I wish I ___ that comment in the meeting yesterday. (not / make)
item.why: Regret about the past: *wish* + *had* + 3rd form.
item.why_lv: Nožēla par pagātni: *wish + had* + 3. forma.

r20-6-018.gate_key: cond_advanced | B2.2 | gap | We'll start at nine unless the speaker ___ late. (be) |

item.q: We'll start at nine unless the speaker ___ late. (be)
item.why: *unless* already means *if … not*: no second *not*.
item.why_lv: *unless* jau nozīmē *if* … *not*: otru noliegumu *neliek*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "ja *vien* nekavēsies", iznāk divi *noliegumi*.

r20-6-019.gate_key: cond_advanced | B2.2 | gap | ___ I known about the strike, I would have booked another flight. (have) |

item.q: ___ I known about the strike, I would have booked another flight. (have)
item.why: Formal, without *if*: *Had I known*.
item.why_lv: Formāli, bez *if*: *Had I known.*

r20-6-020.gate_key: unreal_time | B2.2 | gap | It's high time the government ___ something about housing. (do) |

item.q: It's high time the government ___ something about housing. (do)
item.why: *It's (high) time* + subject + past: it should already happen.
item.why_lv: *It's* (*high*) *time* + teikuma priekšmets + pagātne: tam jau vajadzētu *notikt*.

r20-6-021.gate_key: unreal_time | B2.2 | gap | I'd rather you ___ my phone without asking. (not / use) |

item.q: I'd rather you ___ my phone without asking. (not / use)
item.why: *I'd rather* + another person + past.
item.why_lv: *I'd rather* + cits cilvēks + pagātne.

r20-6-022.gate_key: rep_verbs | B2.2 | gap | She insisted ___ for the whole dinner. (pay) |

item.q: She insisted ___ for the whole dinner. (pay)
item.why: *insist on* + *-ing*.
item.why_lv: *insist on + -ing*.

r20-6-023.gate_key: ind_advanced | B2.2 | gap | We couldn't decide where ___ on holiday. (go) |

item.q: We couldn't decide where ___ on holiday. (go)
item.why: Not knowing what to do: question word + *to* + base form.
item.why_lv: *Nezinot*, ko darīt: jautājamais vārds + to + pamatforma. *Tulkojot burtiski* "kur *mums braukt*", iznāk jautājuma secība.

r20-6-024.gate_key: cond_advanced | B2.2 | gap | ___ I in your position, I would ask for a pay rise. (be) |

item.q: ___ I in your position, I would ask for a pay rise. (be)
item.why: Formal, without *if*: *Were I* (not *Was I*).
item.why_lv: Formāli, bez *if*: *Were I* (nevis *Was I*).

r20-6-025.gate_key: cond_advanced | B2.2 | gap | If it ___ for your advice, I would never have applied. (not / be) |

item.q: If it ___ for your advice, I would never have applied. (not / be)
item.why: *If it hadn't been for* + noun = without it, in the past.
item.why_lv: *If it hadn't been for* + lietvārds = bez tā, pagātnē.

r20-6-026.gate_key: rep_verbs | B2.2 | gap | The minister denied ___ the report before it was published. (see) |

item.q: The minister denied ___ the report before it was published. (see)
item.why: *deny* + *-ing* (or *having* + 3rd form).
item.why_lv: *deny + -ing* (vai *having* + 3. forma).

r20-6-027.gate_key: rep_verbs | B2.2 | gap | They accused the company ___ the data of its users. (sell) |

item.q: They accused the company ___ the data of its users. (sell)
item.why: *accuse someone of* + *-ing*.
item.why_lv: *accuse someone of + -ing*. *Tulkojot burtiski* "apsūdzēja par", *gribas for*.

r20-6-028.gate_key: ind_advanced | B2.2 | gap | ___ wins the competition will get a trip to Lisbon. (who) |

item.q: ___ wins the competition will get a trip to Lisbon. (who)
item.why: *Whoever* = it does not matter who: the person who.
item.why_lv: *Whoever* = nav svarīgi, kurš: tas, kurš.

r20-6-029.gate_key: ind_advanced | B2.2 | gap | It depends on ___ the budget is approved or not. |

item.q: It depends on ___ the budget is approved or not.
item.why: After a preposition use *whether*, not *if*.
item.why_lv: Aiz prievārda lieto *whether*, nevis *if*.

r20-6-030.gate_key: unreal_time | B2.2 | gap | It's about time you ___ to the dentist. (go) |

item.q: It's about time you ___ to the dentist. (go)
item.why: *It's about time* + subject + past.
item.why_lv: *It's about time* + teikuma priekšmets + pagātne.

r20-6-031.gate_key: cond_advanced | B2.2 | gap | If only I ___ my passport at home! (not / leave) |

item.q: If only I ___ my passport at home! (not / leave)
item.why: Regret about the past: *If only* + *had* + 3rd form.
item.why_lv: Nožēla par pagātni: *If only + had* + 3. forma.

item.why: *It's (high / about) time* + subject + past: it should happen now, and it is already late.

item.why: *I'd rather / I'd sooner* + base form: what I prefer to do myself.
item.why_lv: *I'd rather / I'd sooner* + pamatforma: ko es *pats* labāk darītu.

item.why_lv: *I'd rather / I'd sooner* + pamatforma: ko es *pats* labāk darītu.

item.why: *I'd rather* + another person + past: what I want someone else to do (or not to do).
